title: Raytracer: adaptive soft shadows - probe samples first, the others only at the edges of shadows
author: Claude-JG
description: raytracerImprovements.md O3: per pixel and light, a few samples (the innermost and the outermost of the disk) first; if they agree, the pixel is fully lit or fully in shadow and the other samples are not traced. A setting raytracer.advanced.adaptiveShadowSamples (0 = trace all). Expected 2-5x on the soft shadow term.
releaseNotes: visualizationSettings.raytracer.advanced.adaptiveShadowSamples (default 6): the raytracer traces a few shadow samples first and the others only where they disagree, at the edges of shadows; 0 traces all samples.
